column1: The registration could not be completed.
This password appears in known data breaches, so attackers try it first. Please choose another one.
column2: ይህ Password በሚታወቁ የመረጃ ጥሰቶች ውስጥ ይታያል፣ ስለዚህ አጥቂዎች መጀመሪያ ይሞክሩታል። እባክዎ ሌላ ይምረጡ።

column1: Only when the whole shop works on HTTPS and will keep working: browsers remember it and refuse plain HTTP until it expires.
column2: ሙሉ ሱቁ በHTTPS ሲሰራ እና መስራቱን ሲቀጥል ብቻ፡ Browsers ያስታውሱታል እና እስኪያልቅ ድረስ ግልጽ HTTP አይቀበሉም።

column1: Thank you. The owner of the shop will look at it and, if it was a mistake, let you through.
column2: አመሰግናለሁ። የሱቁ ባለቤት ይመረምረዋል እና ስህተት ከሆነ ያሳልፍዎታል።

column1: This request was stopped for security reasons. If you think this is a mistake, tell the owner of the shop what you were doing:
column2: ይህ ጥያቄ ለደህንነት ሲባል ተገትቷል። ስህተት እንደሆነ ካሰቡ፣ ምን እያደረጉ እንደነበሩ ለሱቁ ባለቤት ይንገሩት፡

column1: Force HTTPS in browsers for 6 months (HSTS)
column2: ለ6 ወራት በBrowsers ውስጥ HTTPS አስገድድ (HSTS)

column1: The password must have at least %1 characters.
[%1] Someone asks you to review a firewall block
column2: [%1] አንድ ሰው የFirewall እገዳ እንዲገመግሙ ይጠይቅዎታል

column1: A visitor stopped by the firewall asks for a review. To let them through or not: bin/magento draco:reviews
column2: በFirewallu የተገታ ጎብኝ ግምገማ ይጠይቃል። እንዲያልፍ ወይም እንዳያልፍ ለመወሰን፡ bin/magento draco:reviews
መግቢያ፣ ምዝገባ እና የሚለጠፍ ማንኛውም ነገር

column1: Stops requests with the shape of an attack (database injection, reading server files, running code, scripts in links) and the scanners that look for weak spots. The admin panel is never inspected. Start with "Log only" for a few days. Emergency exit: 'draco_waf_off' => true in app/etc/env.php. Try it: bin/magento draco:test
column2: የጥቃት ቅርጽ ያላቸው ጥያቄዎች (Database injection፣ የServer Filesን ማንበብ፣ code ማስኬድ፣ በአገናኞች ውስጥ Scripts) እና ደካማ ነጥቦችን የሚፈልጉ Scannersን ያቆማል። የአስተዳዳሪ Panel በጭራሽ አይመረመርም። ለጥቂት ቀናት በ"Log only" ይጀምሩ። የአደጋ ጊዜ መውጫ፡ 'draco_waf_off' => true በApp/etc/env.php ውስጥ። ይሞክሩት፡ bin/magento draco:test

column1: Too many pages a minute from one address or one network get "429, come back in a minute". Customers who are logged in and search engines verified by DNS are never limited.
column2: ከአንድ አድራሻ ወይም ከአንድ አውታረ መረብ በደቂቃ በጣም ብዙ ገጾች "429, come back in a minute" ያገኛሉ። የገቡ ደንበኞች እና በDNS የተረጋገጡ የፍለጋ ሞተሮች በጭራሽ አይገደቡም።

column1: Adds an invisible trap and a signed page stamp to the "Create an Account" form, without captchas. Bots get no account; three bot attempts in one day block the address for a week.
column2: ያለ captcha፣ የማይታይ ወጥመድ እና የተፈረመ የገጽ ማህተም ወደ "Create an Account" ቅጽ ይጨምራል። Bots መለያ አያገኙም፤ በአንድ ቀን ሦስት የBot ሙከራዎች አድራሻውን ለአንድ ሳምንት ያግዳሉ።

column1: Refuse or allow visitors by country, from a public list (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) downloaded once a month by cron and looked up locally. Behind Cloudflare its own country header is used.
column2: ጎብኞችን በሀገር እምቢ ማለት ወይም መፍቀድ፣ ከህዝባዊ ዝርዝር (DB-IP Lite, CC BY 4.0) በወር አንድ ጊዜ በcron የሚወርድ እና በአካባቢ የሚፈለግ። ከCloudflare ጀርባ የራሱ የሀገር Header ጥቅም ላይ ይውላል።

column1: Two-letter codes separated by commas, such as RU, CN.
column2: በኮማ የተለዩ የሁለት ፊደል ኮዶች፣ እንደ RU, CN።

column1: Only change the header when the shop is behind that proxy. A header from any other connection is ignored, so nobody can pose as another address.
column2: Headeruን የሚቀይሩት ሱቁ ከዚያ Proxy ጀርባ ሲሆን ብቻ ነው። ከማንኛውም ሌላ ግንኙነት የሚመጣ Header ችላ ይባላል፣ ስለዚህ ማንም እንደ ሌላ አድራሻ መሆን አይችልም።

column1: Addresses or CIDR ranges, separated by commas. Empty: this machine and private networks. Cloudflare's ranges are already known.
column2: አድራሻዎች ወይም CIDR ክልሎች፣ በኮማ ተለይተው። ባዶ ከሆነ፡ ይህ ማሽን እና የግል አውታረ መረቦች። የCloudflare ክልሎች አስቀድመው ይታወቃሉ።

column1: CIDR ranges, one per line, added to the ones Draco knows.
column2: CIDR ክልሎች፣ በአንድ መስመር አንድ፣ ከDraco ከሚያውቃቸው ጋር ይጨምራሉ።

column1: Separated by commas, on top of the last addresses administrators logged in from.
column2: በኮማ ተለይተው፣ አስተዳዳሪዎች ከገቡባቸው የመጨረሻ አድራሻዎች በተጨማሪ።

column1: Start of the path, one per line, such as webhooks that receive signed payloads.
column2: የዱካው መጀመሪያ፣ በአንድ መስመር አንድ፣ እንደ የተፈረሙ ጭነቶችን የሚቀበሉ webhooks።

column1: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy and Permissions-Policy. Draco never replaces a header the shop already sends.
column2: nosniff, SAMEORIGIN, Referrer-Policy እና Permissions-Policy። Draco ሱቁ አስቀድሞ የሚልከውን Header በጭራሽ አይተካም።

column1: Applied when a customer chooses a password: sign-up, account page, reset link and the API. Existing passwords keep working.
column2: ደንበኛ Password ሲመርጥ ይተገበራል፡ ምዝገባ፣ የመለያ ገጽ፣ የዳግም ማስጀመሪያ አገናኝ እና API። ያሉት Passwords መስራታቸውን ይቀጥላሉ።

column1: Refuse passwords that appear in known data breaches
column2: በሚታወቁ የመረጃ ጥሰቶች የሚታዩ Passwordsን እምቢ በል

column1: Asks Have I Been Pwned with only the first 5 characters of the password's SHA-1: the password never leaves your server. If the service does not answer in 3 seconds, the password is accepted.
column2: Have I Been Pwned ን Passwordu SHA-1 የመጀመሪያዎቹ 5 ቁምፊዎች ብቻ ይጠይቃል፡ Passwordu ከServerዎ በጭራሽ አይወጣም። አገልግሎቱ በ3 ሰከንድ ውስጥ ካልመለሰ፣ Passwordu ይቀበላል።

column1: Visitors stopped by the firewall can ask for a review from the block page. You get at most one e-mail an hour; decide with bin/magento draco:reviews.
column2: በFirewallu የተገቱ ጎብኞች ከእገዳ ገጹ ግምገማ ሊጠይቁ ይችላሉ። በሰዓት አንድ Email ብቻ ያገኛሉ፤ በbin/magento draco:reviews ይወስኑ።

column1: Empty: the store's general contact e-mail.
column2: ባዶ ከሆነ፡ የሱቁ አጠቃላይ የእውቂያ Email።
